question: The 36th National Games were inaugurated in__________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 36th National Games were inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 
• The inauguration ceremony took place on 29th September 2022.
 
• The event was held at the Narendra Modi Stadium, which is known to be the world's largest cricket stadium.
 
• This edition of the National Games was significant as it was being held after a gap of seven years.
 
• Gujarat hosted the National Games for the first time in history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Games of India**

 
 
• The National Games of India are a multi-sport event held in various states of India.
 
• The first edition was held in 1924 in Lahore, which is now in Pakistan.
 
• These games are organized by the Indian Olympic Association.
 
• The aim is to promote a sports culture in the country and provide a platform for athletes to showcase their talents.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi Stadium**
 
 
• Located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, the Narendra Modi Stadium is the largest cricket stadium in the world.
 
• It has a seating capacity of 132,000 spectators.
 
• The stadium was renovated and renamed in 2021, previously known as Sardar Patel Stadium.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**
 
 
• Narendra Modi has been serving as the Prime Minister of India since May 2014.
 
• He was the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014.
 
• Under his leadership, various national and international events have been successfully organized in India.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**
 
 
• Gujarat is a state on the western coast of India with a coastline of 1,600 km (990 mi).
 
• It is known for its significant contributions to India's economic growth and development.
 
• The state has a rich cultural heritage and is famous for its traditional dance forms like Garba and Dandiya.
